SWZ.note: Describes a centre of excellence and planned testing lab, not a rule, authority or enforcement on AI harms.

facts.fact: ESWASA, the national standards body, and AICE Africa say ESWASA's EswasaOne AI platform, linking standards information, certification and inspection workflows, is being developed, with planned features still to come.

systems.platform: AI platform with conversational interface and workflow automation

SWZ.note: No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated; EswasaOne is the standards body's own workflow tool.

systems.system: AI Safety and Standards Research and Testing Laboratory

SWZ.note: Only a proposed testing laboratory with no named funder or site; no model, dataset or AI computing stated.
Nothing on digital financial services protection.
ISO/IEC 42001 and 23894 are named as reference points only; no membership, adoption, rule or committee seat stated.

facts.fact: The release describes ESWASA as Eswatini's national standards body, established under the Standards and Quality Act of 2003, amended in 2023.
